single_runtime_executable.name: uwvm2-ros
single_runtime_executable.goal: One ELF per Linux target, as static as the actual supported runtime/provider contract permits
single_runtime_executable.language_compilers: SDK build dependencies; never infer a runtime release dependency from their presence
single_runtime_executable.install_selection: Installed PATH default uwvm2-ros, or explicit trusted runtime path in the existing command-run configuration

execution_contract.permissions: Explicit user/runtime policy only; no SDK implicit grants, feature switches, EH overrides or native ROS business fallback
execution_contract.application_operand: Launcher appends the sole --run with already-built target; run does not compile

required_install_identity: ELF full SHA256 and target/source/build identity
Actual supported Wasm proposals and exact import signatures/semantics
Memory/table width and limits, threads/TLS/EH/GC constraints
Native runtime providers, actual dynamic dependencies and paired unwind closure
ROS distribution/RMW/type-support/generated message ABI and permission/audit contract
capability_manifest_producer.consumer_rule: Missing producer or an unmatched identity is BLOCKED; an enum/version string is not support

tls_threads_eh_memory.guest_TLS: Thread-local storage requires actual Wasm TLS/thread initialization, shared memory, atomics and scheduling qualification. SDK target profiles currently declare threads=false. Native ELF TLS is a different property.
tls_threads_eh_memory.transport_TLS: DDS/network transport encryption belongs to explicit native provider policy; Wasm TLS storage or WASI sockets do not establish encrypted ROS transport.
tls_threads_eh_memory.guest_EH: noeh and modern wasm exceptions are separate compile profiles; emitted proposal and generated code must be inventoried and actually run.
tls_threads_eh_memory.native_EH_CFI_unwind: Native paired unwind/CFI and mandatory generated-chain checked unwind/no body fallback need original runtime evidence for every actual app.
tls_threads_eh_memory.memory_table: Wasm32/64 and table32/64 are independent; exact emitted types/limits and actual runtime support are mandatory. Existing 64-bit target descriptor currently requests memory64 and table64.
tls_threads_eh_memory.multi_module: Binary, indexed static archive and shared/preload graph pin every complete module SHA and import signature; never treat a native shared object as the guest module.

public_release_smoke.rule: Reuse existing public entry; absent environment, quarantined required capability and zero cases return non-success. No private receipt/snapshot runner.
